contributors: Christopher Daniel Pang supplied the PAL order, the RPL return, the PECAN owner-address question and the BLA common frame. Hearthline derived the transport, strip, compensator and self-calibration results in his independent research program.
formal_scope: A bounded local injection on the actual self-sized prime boards 16^(j+1), with radius B*4^(j+1)*(j+1)^2, implies stock RH. Occupancy determines a coarse bound on each board height. Even arbitrary independent strip slopes converge to one under the specified error bound. The finite interval criterion, exact small-strip return and tick rounding have separate proofs.
paper_scope: The far-end rank assignment costs O(1+sqrt(n)+sup abs(theta(t)-t)). Schoenfeld gives the reverse implication from RH. At the earlier fixed multiple addresses the exterior optimum is asymptotic to n/(4*log2(n)) with the stated limiting transport profile. An explicit shrinking omission funds the prescribed target box unconditionally, and the small-distance return gives o(n^2) error through the stated growing inner range. A constant-width multiple of sqrt(n) fails on arbitrarily late self-sized boards. The uniform RH-scale upper bound is open.

review.units: Site distance and free ordinal are distinct. Ordered positions account for two trip directions except at distance zero, where the diagonal has n cells per layer.
review.catch: The fixed-owner optimum measures only exterior travel. The fully movable optimum measures every job. Both use exactly the same integer box height, determined by the actual demand.
review.integer optimum: The greedy construction gives an injection. Its last reset on failure gives a mandatory interval shortage applying to every conceivable injection. An exhaustive permutation calculation checked 3664 small layouts.
review.prefix control: Every cut enters the strip comparison. Checking two sides of prime jumps and the last cut exhausts the finite extrema. One smaller-error interval intersection independently rules out a better integer height.
review.old behaviour: The former full tick-layer arithmetic replay returns exactly its frozen parsed data with the current default codec.
review.scope: One-third of a board is false after the small-strip correction at the next tested geometric head. The unconditional analytic estimates cover only the stated travel or strip ranges. No literature priority claim is made.
